research.title: I Think, Therefore I Attack: Evaluating Thought Injection Attacks on Reasoning Agents
research.summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) are one of the key components of current agentic systems. LRMs augment their output with an explicit chain-of-thought reasoning stage, introducing a new attack surface for thought injection, in which untrusted text resembling the model's own deliberation is fed back to the model.

tryThisToday.title: Prototype a small agent in an hour
steps: Pick one repetitive task you did this week.
Write the steps down as if training a new teammate.
Give an agent framework only the tools those steps need.
Run it on three real examples and log every tool call.
Add a human approval step before any irreversible action.
